headline: Northern Fronts Flare as Attrition Surges Across Contested Sectors
war_summary: Combat has intensified sharply across the northern and central theaters over the past three hours, marked by surging casualty rates and renewed base turnover. Weathered Expanse has erupted into severe tactical flux around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, where combined losses now exceed seventeen hundred per hour alongside multiple ground shifts. Nevish Line similarly reignites with fresh base transitions and mounting enlistments after a brief lull. While strategic turnovers slowed somewhat in Linn of Mercy, the butcher's bill there has accelerated violently, exceeding three thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour window. Marban Hollow preserves its fragile deadlock with ongoing skirmishes around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, accompanied by fresh contestation in Stonecradle at The Reach. Earlier flares in Kuura Strand and Mooring County have largely subsided, though Stlican Shelf exhibits a sharp uptick in frontline contact.
